notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) direct HTTP fetch via curl_cffi (impersonate chrome124) to https://www.etsy.com/c/home-and-living returned HTTP 403 with a DataDome CAPTCHA challenge (captcha-delivery.com iframe payload). Tier (b) Playwright headless chromium hit the identical DataDome CAPTCHA wall on the same URL. robots.txt (fetched directly, full 1818 lines checked) has no Disallow entry naming any Claude/Anthropic bot; only a generic 'User-agent: *' block with narrow path Disallows (cart, messages, api, etc.) plus query-string exclusions (/search?*q=, *ship_to=*, *price_bucket=*, *attr_*=*, /c/*attr_*=* etc.) - none of which block plain /c/<slug> category browsing, so tier (c) was permitted. Proceeded to tier (c) Claude-in-Chrome, which loaded all pages successfully (the authenticated Chrome session was not challenged the way the bare HTTP/Playwright clients were). All data pulled via navigate + JS DOM extraction (document.querySelector for h1/canonical, and a text-node scan for the '<N> items' / '<N> results' count string) rather than screenshots or LLM page reads. TREE: Etsy is a marketplace; used its own Home & Living taxonomy (https://www.etsy.com/c/home-and-living), expanding 'Show more' to see all 16 top-level groups (Home Decor, Furniture, Floor & Rugs, Outdoor & Gardening, Lighting, Bathroom, Kitchen & Dining, Bedding, Storage & Organisation, Curtains & Window Treatments, Office, Spirituality & Religion, Food & Drink, Home Improvement, Home Appliances, Cleaning Supplies). Walked every subcategory tile (1-2 levels deep, following each page's own <a href> set restricted to its own URL prefix) under: Bedding, Storage & Organisation, Curtains & Window Treatments, Floor & Rugs, Bathroom, Kitchen & Dining (Linens + Kitchen Storage branches), Home Decor (incl. Decorative Storage and Wall Decor branches), Office, and Outdoor & Gardening; Furniture/Lighting/Home Improvement/Home Appliances/Cleaning Supplies/Spirituality/Food & Drink were scanned at the top level only and contained no textile/storage leaves. Confirmed h1 matched the requested node on every leaf recorded. A node with further sub-tiles was NOT itself recorded (grouping row only, per the parent-URL rule) - this occasionally yields sparse coverage where Etsy's own curated child tiles (e.g. Boxes & Bins -> only 'Tins' + 'Remote Control Caddies') do not exhaustively partition the parent's real inventory. QTY: Etsy shows either an exact 'NNN results' figure or, once the true count exceeds roughly 1000, a capped '1,000+ items' badge - the site's own UI ceiling, it does not disclose the true count beyond that point. Exact figures under the cap were recorded as int with the literal displayed string as evidence; capped ones were recorded as qty=null with flag 'MANUAL REVIEW: Etsy displays a capped 1,000+ items indicator, exact count not disclosed by the site UI' (null + MANUAL REVIEW is the correct answer here, not fabrication). EXCLUDED: Bedding, Curtains & Window Treatments, Storage & Organisation, Bathroom, Kitchen & Dining, Boxes & Bins, Shelving, Jewellery Storage, Laundry Bags & Hampers, Decorative Storage, Kitchen Storage, Linens - all dropped as bare parent rows (valid subcategory leaves exist beneath each, so only appear as is_group rows). Shelving Brackets, Curtain Hardware, Towel Racks & Rods, Toilet Paper Holders, Soap Dishes & Dispensers, Bathroom Vanities, Bathroom Decor, Napkin Holders, Paper Towel Holders, Beeswax Food Wrappers - excluded as hardware/fixtures/generic decor/gadgets, not textile or storage. Ladders and Recycling & Trash excluded from Storage (ladders are access tools not storage; recycling/trash bins are waste-disposal, not storage/organization). Wall Hangings (Home Decor > Wall Decor) excluded from Textile - it is one mixed generic node not split into a fabric-specific subcategory, so the textile subset could not be isolated without classifying all Wall Decor as Textile. Wall Shelves excluded from Storage - explicitly placed under Wall Decor by the site's own hierarchy, not Storage & Organisation. Decorative Trays and Decorative Bowls (under Home Decor > Decorative Storage) excluded per the explicit rule excluding decorative-only trays/bowls from Storage. Banks & Cash Boxes (Office) excluded - financial/security storage, out of scope. Kitchen & Dining > Linens > Hampers excluded as a duplicate of the same 810-result Hampers leaf already recorded once under Storage & Organisation > Laundry Bags & Hampers (identical count, reached via a second navigation path). Also excluded throughout: apparel/fashion, pet products, craft/jewelry/art supplies, wedding goods, digital downloads, and all non-Home & Living marketplace verticals - none of these appeared inside the walked Home & Living tree. LOCALE NOTE: the Chrome session geo-detected as India (INR currency, 'Etsy India' page titles, canonical URLs carrying an /in-en/ locale prefix) rather than a US locale; no in-page control to force a US locale was found. Etsy's product catalog and category taxonomy are global/shared across locales (only currency/language/shipping display is localized), so the recorded category structure and item counts are treated as the same ones a US visitor would see; links below are recorded using the canonical www.etsy.com/c/... path with the /in-en/ locale segment stripped.
